correctness.rationale: The fully bidirected wheel with four rim vertices has 16 ordered arcs. An arc subset is a multipath precisely if indegree/outdegree<=1 and there are no directed cycles. Independent exhaustive 2^16 mask traversal found 260 nonempty faces with f=(16,76,120,48), complete face Hasse graph with 704 covers, exactly 116 deterministic Morse pairs, acyclicity of all 260 nodes after reversing matched covers, and unmatched cells one 0-cell, 19 two-cells and 8 three-cells. Independent signed integer Morse reduction gives the full 19x8 differential identically zero; Hurewicz for the wedge of S2 makes all 3-cell attachments nullhomotopic, proving integral wedge ^19 S2 and ^8 S3. Independently built rational 120x48 third-boundary matrix of rank 40 and signed D4 arc action; the H3 character on 5 class types is (8,0,0,0,0), hence regular, and reduced Lefschetz formula yields H2=(19,3,-1,1,1), decomposing 3A1+2A2+3B1+3B2+4E. These are exhaustive exact finite checks of this graph, not extrapolated family claims.

It explicitly does not determine integral homotopy type, torsion, or dihedral action. The present exact acyclic integer Morse differential establishes a mixed wedge (not implied solely by F2 Betti ranks) and complete new D4 rational characters. Caputi–Collari–Smith 2026 Theorem 2.10 addresses pure bidirected polygons, no hub; other fan and alternate-spoke wheel computations do not imply this fully bidirected W5 group action. Best-of-knowledge PASS for surviving integral homotopy plus representation.
